product_one_liner.value: Haptiq provides AI-powered enterprise software that unifies data, automates workflows and delivers decision-making insights for public and private companies, asset managers, governments, institutions and family offices.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing link found; the contact page offers a sales-enquiry form.

named_customers.notes: Named logos appear under “Trusted by teams who don’t wait.”

founded_year.notes: Haptiq-specific profiles report 2009; the 2022 acquisition announcement separately describes predecessor Webonise as founded in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains business, product, hiring and release-update content; no qualifying pair of engineer-authored accounts of building Haptiq’s own product was found.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help portal linked from the site was found; checks of docs.haptiq.com and help.haptiq.com yielded no readable documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-positions board lists Head of Data Engineering & AI, explicitly leading an AI/ML team.

model_provider.notes: Haptiq’s CTO describes its production enterprise AI platform as built on LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic and OpenAI; no specific OpenAI model is identified.

compliance_certs.notes: Credit AI explicitly runs on Haptiq’s SOC 2 Type II–audited platform.

last_funding.notes: Latest publicly documented investment located: Pearl Street Equity’s acquisition/investment in Webonise, now Haptiq; amount undisclosed, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly documented investment located is April 2022, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable jobs listing names Haptiq’s Principal Account Executive in New York and marks it “Actively Hiring”; a standalone posting was not accessible.

launched_6mo.notes: May 28, 2026: Olympus Credit introduced a full compliance engine, company module, testing dashboard, rules interface and 19 validated concentration tests.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bhuvan Khanna’s profile describes his Haptiq role as GM and Chief Product Officer and dates its end to May 2026, inside the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales-operations job description names HubSpot and Salesforce as CRM examples and requests hands-on HubSpot or similar experience; these are hiring signals rather than a definitive inventory. The posting closed May 29, 2026.
